description: `Players.alive()` arma un array con filter en cada llamada y `nearest()` lo llama por frame (Kuntur, Spirit, cada Pickup; Pickup además `get_overlapping_bodies().has(player)` por frame). Cada Hitbox hace `_airborne.duplicate()` cada frame aunque esté vacío. Los DebugOverlay.watch del player y del jefe arman strings, snappedf y `State.keys()` cada frame también en release.
notes: Done (335c775d). Pickup: any player touching it can pick it up (before only the nearest could), which is better in co-op. A Hitbox only sleeps if it is plain Hitbox: Projectile, HammerStrike and Explosion use their own _physics_process. The boss blackboard keeps hand_left/right as BossHand.State (int); the overlay shows the name.
